summary: The rule default contract judges an on-demand rule's size against the runtime's per-file truncation limit, advisory and cited
acceptance: a path-scoped rule over the cited limit draws one advisory naming the truncation; an unscoped rule does not; cargo test green
tests: a path scoped rule past the on demand size limit draws the rule size advisory
pins: an unscoped rule past the on demand size limit draws no rule size advisory
notes: memory docs (retrieved 2026-11-26, via summary; re-verify): an on-demand file past 40,000 characters at a 200K window (larger on 1M) is cut to its start; launch-loaded files are whole to 4 MiB. Guard on `paths` presence. Where the docs scale by window, judge the smallest documented and say so in the guidance.
